scores.evidence: Wave 0 setup → Wave 1 platform and core modules → Wave 2 the slice → Wave 3 evaluations; "M3 Depends on M1 go decision, S3 passed"
scores.rationale: Substrate (infra, store, queue, gateways, policy) precedes workers, then evals and gated resolve pilot, with explicit dependencies and go/no-go gates.

scores.evidence: Slice exit: labelling a seeded bug issue `agent:resolve` produces a draft PR with passing tests through the deployed dev pipeline
scores.rationale: M1 is an end-to-end deployed slice before features, though on a playground repo and dev env rather than real prod.

scores.evidence: D5 ... Hard (trust model); D9 Python 3.12 ... Revisit if: The team is mainly TypeScript (A5) → switch before M1 code
scores.rationale: Decisions table lists options, reversibility, and revisit triggers, plus assumptions table with impact and validation.

scores.evidence: Wave 1: platform and core modules ... Policy Engine, GitHub Gateway, Model Gateway before workers; import-linter rules in T3
scores.rationale: Widest-impact shared components (schema, gateways, policy) are built before leaf workers and features.

scores.evidence: T4 Register GitHub App ... no Workflows, Actions or Secrets; T11 Policy Engine; T12 egress tests fail; M3 security review
scores.rationale: Security controls appear in every build wave from the first (app permissions, HMAC, policy, sandbox isolation, adversarial cases, CI audit).

scores.evidence: Observability (M1 baseline, dashboards in M2); T15 Add observability: JSON logs with correlation IDs, OTel traces
scores.rationale: Observability is in M1 but added as task T15 after the core modules rather than from the first task, with dashboards and alerts deferred to M2.

scores.evidence: Terraform the dev env ... remote state; `uv`, Alembic migrations up/down in CI; prompts versioned; eval cases store commit SHAs; weekly image rebuilds
scores.rationale: Reproducible infra, dependencies, migrations, sandbox images, prompt/model versions, and eval data are threaded across phases.

scores.evidence: T8 a worker killed mid-job → another worker completes it once; Flow 3 failure; Reconciler; rollback kill switch
scores.rationale: Idempotency, leases, retries, fallbacks and reconciler appear in M1 build tasks and in later milestones (env health auto-disable, restore drill).

scores.evidence: Evaluation sets come first (§14) ... Human approval points: the fix trigger ... Model Gateway budgets ... Policy Engine
scores.rationale: Policy, budgets, and human approval are built before the model-facing workers, then model gateway, single-call triage, agent loop, and feedback loop; no memory/routing bloat, ordering is mostly right.

scores.evidence: Deferred Work table: "Auto-triggered fixes for high agent_fit issues | Merge rate ≥ 40% and evaluations show agent_fit predicts success"
scores.rationale: Explicit deferred items each with concrete pull-forward triggers, plus non-goals and deliberate shortcuts.

note: Very strong, well-ordered plan; only observability is slightly late in Phase 0 task order and dashboards/alerts wait for M2.
